about: A tool that automates file management with simple rules.

prs.title: The lowercase extensions rule leaves files without one alone
prs.broken: The documented rule for making file extensions lowercase also matched files with no extension, so a file like LICENSE was renamed with a stray dot at the end.
prs.changed: The extension filter with no list now matches only files that have an extension.
prs.matters: People who copy the example rule from the docs no longer get broken file names.
